reason: B is the stronger proposal because localized HEA laser cladding can restore lost surface material while limiting the heat-affected zone, and it provides quantitative outcomes and direct comparisons with fusion repair and untreated controls. Its rapid-solidification/high-entropy rationale overstates crack avoidance and the composition and temperature boundaries need tightening, but A neither specifies an HEA nor demonstrates how FSP alone would rebuild a damaged surface.
